test_coverage_notes: The code relies heavily on beast::SemanticVersion for parsing and validation, so test coverage depends on both direct tests of BuildInfo.cpp and tests of SemanticVersion. Typical test files would be in the unit test suite for protocol/BuildInfo or protocol/BuildInfo_test.cpp, as well as tests for version encoding/decoding and error handling (e.g., invalid version strings, out-of-range values, malformed pre-release identifiers). Gaps may exist if there are no tests for malformed version strings, edge cases for range checks, or unusual pre-release identifiers. There is no evidence in this file of explicit test hooks or test-only code.
